citations.quote: Nicole Cannizzaro was born and raised in Las Vegas.

items.role: Prosecutor; later Chief Deputy District Attorney in the Gang Unit

citations.quote: Nicole joined the Clark County District Attorney’s Office in 2011, and she was never afraid to take on the toughest cases.
She was eventually appointed as the Chief Deputy District Attorney in the Gang Unit.
Nicole has worked in both private practice and as a prosecutor.
Nicole earned a degree in Business Administration from the University of Nevada, Reno.

items.institution: UNLV William S. Boyd School of Law

citations.quote: Following college, she moved back to Las Vegas, where she earned her law degree from the UNLV Boyd School of Law and started her legal career.

occupation.value: Prosecutor; Majority Leader of the Nevada State Senate

citations.quote: Nicole Cannizzaro is a mom, a lifelong Nevadan, a prosecutor, and the first woman to serve as Majority Leader of the Nevada State Senate

items.office: Member of the Nevada State Senate (Majority Leader)

citations.quote: Nicole has served in the State Senate since 2016, and just a few years later, she became the first woman to serve as State Senate Majority Leader. She has been elected by her colleagues to serve as Majority Leader for four consecutive legislative sessions.
